name: esqhv8-hub-message-session
goal: A Hub Home chat box delivers Daniel's message into the Chief of Staff pane, and each session's Message button into that exact live run's pane, over the linked-computer connection with the Mac Home upload off; receipts show stored, delivered and acknowledged, and the session's tracker reply appears in the Hub thread, on desktop and phone width

evidence: Today Message buttons only open the Agents dialog; the composer writes a 'Hub message:' NOTE (POST /api/hub-home/chat, refused on prod with the upload off) and nothing types it into a session; 'sent' means a note was stored and replies are guessed from the last 5 notes. Expected: CoS chat box + per-session Message deliver into the cos pane / that exact live run pane via TrackerTmuxAdapter, never another run, with receipts stored/delivered/acknowledged and a keyed tracker reply shown in the Hub thread. Repro: hub-home e2e with a linked Mac (no upload) sending a CoS message; tracker unit with a fake cos pane.

No test covered message delivery at all: hub-home specs fake POST /api/hub-home/chat and assert only 'Sent to Tracker'; tracker tests cover nudges for digests/handoffs but no Hub message path, receipt or reply. Gap: no fixture models a message's lifecycle (stored -> pane -> reply). Reusable change: hubSessionMessages note format + fold (tested), a local API /messages test, a delivery test with a fake watchdog port, and the linked-computers fixture answering homeChat kind 'message' and serving threads in homeSnapshot.
